title: Inulin's paradoxical effect on Ca(II)-alginate encapsulation of phenolic extracts
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00851D, Paper

Peyman Ebrahimi, Alberto De Iseppi, Zeynep Gülbeş, Elisa Canazza, Jacopo Nava, Barbara Simonato, Corrado Rizzi, Dasha Mihaylova, Anna Lante
Previous studies report conflicting effects for inulin on encapsulation efficiency in Ca(II)–alginate systems; this study clarifies inulin’s actual role as a co-carrier.
